description: Persistent prioritized improvement backlog for goal-loop autonomous improvement loops. Items are de-duplicated by id and dedupeKeys; planners should select the highest-priority unblocked open item not already satisfied by completed conditions/history.

items.title: Goal/profile-aware verification matrix beyond bun run check
items.finding: Correctness gates can hinge on transcript evidence and configured checks (bun run check, optional evaluator.verifyCommand) while missing integration behavior, flakiness, perf regressions, security issues, or untested edge paths.
items.improvement: Implemented profile-aware verification matrix (config verifyChecks/verifyProfile, legacy verifyCommand synthesis), broad-goal scoping/unscoped-required-check detection, per-check command/output/exit evidence recorded in verdict trail and dossier, and evaluator rubric/prompt guidance treating missing/unscoped required verification as not_met with concrete next actions. Backward-compatible with legacy single verifyCommand. Follow-up: NL goal-declared checks, deterministic coverage enforcement, concurrency/reuse/timing, and artifact-evidence modes reduce prior honest limits while preserving fresh-evidence guarantees.
evidence: Goal-loop blind spot #1 (2026-11-20): met can hinge on transcript evidence + configured checks but miss system health dimensions.
SPEC.md Workstream LXXVI/LXXX+: evaluator accepts only fresh evidence; verifyCommand gate is optional and command-specific.

Workstream LXXXVIII (2026-11-20): src/core/config.ts/types.ts/wire.ts/prompts.ts, src/runtime/controller.ts, src/core/dossier.ts record and render per-check matrix evidence; tests cover pass/fail/unscoped/broad/legacy cases; bun run check exit 0 on merge commit.

Follow-up (2026-11-20): reduced honest limits with goal-declared verify directives parsed/merged from condition (structured verify: syntax), deterministic runtime coverage policy (rubric-independent) for broad/scope required checks, concurrent command execution with cap/reuse-caching/timing metadata, and explicit command|artifact|either evidence modes with artifact patterns (no narration fallback); tests cover NL parse/malformed, deterministic unscoped rejection, parallel/reuse, artifact-vs-command, backward compat; bun run check exit 0.

items.title: Persistent prioritized backlog/ledger with de-duplication
items.finding: Next iterations rely on summaries/hints and repo re-reads; without a persistent backlog, prioritization can be ad hoc and important issues can be forgotten or repeated.
items.improvement: Maintain a machine-readable backlog/ledger in-repo (findings, impact, risk, evidence, status, dedupe keys). Have the planner select the highest-value unblocked item and de-duplicate against completed conditions/history. Feed from audits, failing checks, TODO/FIXME, and telemetry.
evidence: Goal-loop blind spot #3 (2026-11-20): no durable prioritized backlog; planning relies on summaries/hints.
This iteration seeds docs/improvement-backlog.json and src/core/improvement-backlog.ts.

Mechanism shipped: src/core/improvement-backlog.ts (validate/parse/dedupe/select) plus docs/improvement-backlog.json and src/runtime/controller.ts selectBacklogSuggestion() de-duplicating against completed conditions/history and feeding NextGoalRequest.backlogSuggestion; pinned by test/improvement-backlog.test.ts and test/loop.test.ts.

items.title: Failure-signature detection with automatic strategy escalation
items.finding: Activity is not always meaningful progress; repeated not-met evaluations could cycle on the same strategy/failure without runtime escalation.
items.improvement: Implemented runtime repeated failure-signature detection for goal/loop evaluations (src/core/failure-signature.ts): consecutive same-signature not_met verdicts (default threshold 3) are detected from verdict history, including structured verification-matrix/legacy gate failures and normalized reason gaps. On detection the controller escalates by pausing with pauseCause=repeated_failure and an explicit strategy-rotation/diagnostic/block reason instead of re-arming the same approach (src/runtime/controller.ts), with HUD/wire/types support and tests.
evidence: Goal-loop blind spot #4 (2026-11-20): repeated not-met loops may cycle on the same strategy without learning from repeated failure signatures.
src/core/failure-signature.ts computes verification/reason signatures and detects trailing repeated not_met runs; src/runtime/controller.ts pauses on detection instead of continueWith.
src/core/types.ts, src/core/wire.ts, src/core/hud.ts add repeated_failure pause cause/remediation.

test/failure-signature.test.ts and test/controller.test.ts cover signature detection, verification failures, and controller escalation/block behavior; bun run check expected/passing for this iteration.

items.title: Standing invariants for improvement loops and post-merge invariant sweep
items.finding: A loop can land a valid local fix while leaving adjacent invariants, API/doc drift, or latent debt untouched.
items.improvement: Add standing invariants for improvement loops: no new warnings, docs/SPEC/changelog alignment when behavior changes, boundary/type/schema consistency checks, and regression tests required for risky-path changes. Consider a post-merge invariant sweep iteration.
evidence: Goal-loop blind spot #2 (2026-11-20): local fix != repository-wide improvement.
Recent passes caught wire.ts boundary gaps during audit rather than as a standing gate.

Already landed on dev before this audit: scripts/invariant-sweep.ts fails when src/core|src/runtime behavior changes lack SPEC.md + docs/changelog.html in the same change set; wired into bun run check; pinned by test/invariant-sweep.test.ts. Remaining sub-items (no-new-warnings, full boundary consistency) stay tracked as general polish rather than re-opening the landed gate.

items.title: Strengthen evaluator rubric with evidence types and adversarial self-check
items.finding: A single evaluator interpreting transcript evidence can misjudge completeness, accept weak evidence, or miss subtle regressions; calibration is not visible.
items.improvement: Require evidence types per claim in the rubric, add adversarial self-check ('what would falsify met?'), and for high-risk/ambiguous conditions use dual-evaluation or mandatory verifier-command corroboration.
evidence: Goal-loop blind spot #5 (2026-11-20): evaluator/judge is a single point of failure.
src/core/prompts.ts contains the evaluator rubric; evaluator.verifyCommand is optional.

Already landed on dev before this audit: src/core/prompts.ts carries the adversarial falsify-met self-check, evidence-type/verifier-corroboration rule; evaluator.consensus (1|2) is wired in src/runtime/evaluator.ts and src/core/config.ts; pinned by test/core.test.ts.

items.title: Coordinator semantic-conflict and drift guards
items.finding: Leases/merge-next reduce direct conflicts, but semantic conflicts, stale assumptions after other merges, or environment/worktree drift can slip through if re-validation is incomplete.
items.improvement: Enforce pre-submit/pre-merge rebase+full-gate on the merged result with explicit drift/failure reporting, run a quick post-merge health pass, and surface overlapping semantic risk (shared modules/APIs) before merge.
evidence: Goal-loop blind spot #6 (2026-11-20): coordinator/concurrency and drift risks.
packages/coordinator/bin/coordinator merge-next already trial-merges and gates merged result; semantic overlap surfacing is limited.

Closed 2026-11-20 (Workstream CXIII): merge preflight now prints SEMANTIC-RISK for shared-module active leases, a worktree HEAD-tip drift guard fails merges with dev untouched, and a post-merge health pass reports landed-tree cleanliness + SPEC marker. Tests in test/coordinator-merge-safety.test.ts.

items.title: Risk classification and stricter gates for sensitive changes
items.finding: Autonomous improvement may touch sensitive surfaces (deps, auth, migrations, CI/release, data paths) without proportional scrutiny.
items.improvement: Classify changes by risk; require stricter gates/review or human confirmation for high-risk areas, and prefer small, reversible commits with clear rollback points.
evidence: Goal-loop blind spot #7 (2026-11-20): safety and change-risk classification.
Autonomous loops can edit src/runtime, coordinator, install/release paths without explicit risk tiers.

Already landed on dev before this audit: src/core/change-risk.ts implements surface matchers/tiers and formatStrictGateNotice; src/runtime/controller.ts surfaceChangeRiskStrictGate() surfaces the strict-gate notice; pinned by test/change-risk.test.ts.

items.title: Structured outcome telemetry and learning from history
items.finding: History/spend/verdicts are retained, but the system may not learn which interventions reduce failures fastest or where regressions recur.
items.improvement: Add structured outcome telemetry (failure taxonomy, time-to-green, reverted/recurring fixes, flaky checks) and use it to tune prompts, gates, and backlog priority over time.
evidence: Goal-loop blind spot #8 (2026-11-20): limited learning from history.
Records retain verdict/history/spend fields but lack aggregated failure taxonomy and recurrence tracking.

Workstream CV (2026-11-20): src/core/outcome-telemetry.ts aggregates the JSONL learning journal into failure taxonomy, time-to-green, recurring conditions and terminal/verdict counts; src/core/learning-log.ts shares one best-effort parser; src/runtime/controller.ts injects the formatted block through the existing learnings channel; test/outcome-telemetry.test.ts (13 tests) covers parsing, grouping, pairing, formatting/budget and prompt injection; bun run check exit 0.

items.title: Collapse identical ternary bodies in goal-terminal learning entry
items.finding: src/core/learning-log.ts:120 chooses between two object literals that are identical whenever sha is truthy, so the lastVerify/command/code condition can never change the emitted entry.
items.improvement: Collapsed the dead ternary in src/core/learning-log.ts to a single last-history sha guard; both former arms emitted the same object. Added a regression case pinning that a non-zero lastVerify code still records the terminal sha.
evidence: Explore research 2026-11-22: both ternary arms return the same object when sha is truthy.
test/learning-log.test.ts:93,139,164 already assert sha on terminal entries.

items.finding: src/core/outcome-telemetry.ts:139 re-checks isRecord(entry) inside a loop that already continues on !isRecord(entry) at line 121, so the inner guard is unreachable-false.
items.improvement: Call normalizeReason(asString(entry.reason)) directly; add a plain-object turn_verdict with verdict=not_met and assert its reason still lands in failureThemes.

items.title: Precompiling lenient-verdict regexes: benchmarked, rejected (no win)
items.finding: src/core/verdict.ts · lenientFields constructs one verdict-field and one reason RegExp per call on the strict-JSON-failure repair path. Precompiling all patterns at module load was benchmarked and reverted: 2000 lenient parseVerdict calls, best of 20 rounds, 2.50 ms baseline vs 2.51 ms precompiled — no measurable win. The allocation is negligible next to the segment/replace work in the repair path.
items.improvement: No code change. Keep the per-call RegExp construction; do not repeat this experiment without a hotter benchmark. Harness: /tmp/opencode/bench-lenient.ts (2000 calls, best of 20). A broken early variant that used ([sS]*?) instead of ([\s\S]*?) measured 2.34 ms — that was a correctness bug, not a speedup, and must not be cited as evidence.
evidence: 2026-11-23 benchmark: baseline 2.50 ms / 2000 calls; precompiled 2.51 ms / 2000 calls (best of 20); reverted, no commit shipped.
Focused suites verdict-intake + evaluator-agent-foreign: 7 pass / 0 fail after the change; tsc --noEmit clean.
Repo precedent: Workstream CLVII precompiled foreign-verdict patterns with a real 1.9x isolated win — that case was kept; this one was not.

items.title: Authoritative terminal changed events must replace the planning placeholder
items.finding: src/core/entries.ts shouldKeepPlanningPlaceholder() returns true for ANY non-live next snapshot while the cached goal is a planning placeholder, and src/tui.tsx put() returns before setEntries on that flag. apply()'s no-new-gap refusal emits a terminal achieved record straight to `changed`; in that arm path no live snapshot ever follows, so the phantom queued HUD/pill never converges. The comment claiming `changed` events are never suppressed is only true for the isStalePlanningPull branch.
items.improvement: Gate shouldKeepPlanningPlaceholder on fromPull for terminal records, or let a terminal snapshot whose setAt postdates the placeholder replace it. Add a regression in test/entries.test.ts: an authoritative terminal snapshot with a different id must return false. Regenerate dist/tui.js with bun run compile.
evidence: Read-only audit 2026-11-23 of commits 0acda52 / 83779c1 (TUI first-arm HUD fixes).

Deterministic trigger: prior completed condition C, /goal-loop with a near-duplicate of C, planner emits planning-<sid>, arm() no-new-gap gate commits terminal achieved and emits it; put() suppresses via planningInFlight and early-returns.

Landed 2026-11-24 on wt/terminal-planning-placeholder-authority: shouldKeepPlanningPlaceholder now takes fromPull; authoritative `changed` terminal events replace the placeholder; regression in test/entries.test.ts; full check green (157 files, 2409 tests).

items.title: A late pull of the pre-planning live goal must not evict the placeholder
items.finding: isStalePlanningPull() only suppresses null/terminal answers. A pull composed while goal A was still live, delivered after showPlanning() cached the placeholder, resolves to live A; both guards return false and applySnapshot() stores A. The first-arm bar disappears until the real arm lands. planningSeenAt is also never cleared on arm/completion, though after 35s it only delays convergence.
items.improvement: Distinguish a pull issued before the arm from the real arm snapshot (mark the pull request time, or compare setAt against placeholder arrival) and suppress live answers from the pre-planning window. Add a regression in test/entries.test.ts asserting a late pre-planning live snapshot is suppressed.
evidence: Read-only audit 2026-11-23 of commits 0acda52 / 83779c1 (TUI first-arm HUD fixes).
Test: isStalePlanningPull(at, liveA, at+1000) currently returns false; expected true for a pull composed during the planning window.
Landed 2026-11-24 on wt/terminal-planning-placeholder-authority: isStalePlanningPull also suppresses live snapshots stamped before the placeholder; regression pins both sides; full check green.

items.title: Docs overstate evaluator.mode's control of the consensus second vote
items.finding: docs/config.html and README.md say evaluator.mode governs only the opt-in consensus:2 second vote and /goal-loop summarize/next-condition generation. src/runtime/evaluator.ts gates the second vote solely on config.consensus===2 && verdict==='met' and resolves evaluator.model unconditionally; mode is consulted only for loop steps (evaluator.ts:204,226). A user setting mode:'session' still gets a second-vote generation child, which can hit a free-tier gate.
items.improvement: Drop 'consensus:2 second vote' from the mode description in docs/config.html and README.md; state that the second vote is governed by consensus and evaluator.model, and keep the accurate summarize/next-condition clause. No code change.
evidence: Read-only audit 2026-11-23 of commit 99558a2 (evaluator.model/mode wording).
src/runtime/evaluator.ts:128-135 (second vote) vs :204,:226 (mode-gated loop steps).
Landed 2026-11-24 on wt/clarity-consistency-performance: docs/config.html and README.md now attribute the second vote to consensus + evaluator.model; no code change.

items.title: Reject a judge reply driven by a harness-injected bare <goal-evaluation> request
items.finding: The pre-verdict gate in src/core/evaluation-gate.ts abstains before the judge child is spawned, so a request assembled by this repo can never be judged empty. The host still owns the judge child session and can inject a bare <goal-evaluation> (empty <condition>, no evidence) as a direct prompt to that child; verdictFromNativeReport (src/core/evaluator-agent.ts) tolerates a missing condition echo, so such a reply can be accepted as this turn's verdict. Unverified: whether the harness can do this without any event reaching events.ts — no live injection run was performed.
items.improvement: Decide with the harness owner whether an injected bare request is a supported path. If so, require a non-empty echoed condition that matches the expected condition in verdictFromNativeReport (only when expectedCondition is non-empty) and fail closed otherwise; measure how many genuine small-model verdicts omit the echo first, since rejecting all echo-less verdicts previously stalled the loop. Add a regression in test/evaluator-agent-foreign.test.ts.
evidence: Session-history audit 2026-11-24 (lease evaluator-empty-request-abstain): empty-request trigger classified as harness-owned; repo cannot arm an empty condition (core/parse.ts, GoalController.command).
src/core/evaluator-agent.ts:103-105,121-127 — missing condition echo is tolerated by design.

src/index.ts nativeVerdict + src/runtime/controller.ts evaluate — in-repo gate lands before spawnEvaluator; no downstream echo guard was added to keep genuine met/not_met paths byte-for-byte unchanged.
